_meta.provenance: MIXED, OVERWHELMINGLY SYNTHETIC. Read _synthetic and _pageProvenance on every record before trusting any field.
whySynthetic: Pass 2 extraction has not run (ARCHITECTURE.md §6: it is the ship gate). No machine-readable list of the book's ~400 recipes, their roles or their printed page numbers exists yet.
The project documents name exactly ONE book dish together with its page: 'Kokum saar - page 9' (README.md, DESIGN.md §3.3, corrected 2026-11-11). That is the only record here with a real page number.

Every other record is invented to fill a role the fixture corpus needs. Its page number is a PLACEHOLDER and must never be quoted to a user, printed in a UI screenshot that leaves the test suite, or copied into recipes.json.

whatIsReal.sectionNumbersAndNames: Real. Taken from SNACK-LIBRARY.md §2.1, which lists book sections 2, 4, 10, 11, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 28 by number and name. Records whose section is marked _sectionProvenance: SYNTHETIC use a section number the documents never state.
whatIsReal.pageRange: Real. REQUIREMENTS.md §2 gives printed pages 6-165 for recipes, glossary 168-170, index 171 on. All placeholder pages sit inside 6-165 so range validation is exercised, which is also exactly why they look real and are not.
whatIsReal.dishNames: 'Kokum saar' is real (README.md). 'Mango sasam' is real as a dish name (REQUIREMENTS.md §4.7 uses it as the canonical out-of-season example) but its page here is a placeholder. All other names are plausible GSB dishes invented for this fixture.
whatIsReal.roleTaxonomy: SYNTHETIC. REQUIREMENTS.md §3.3 says role comes from the book's 30 section headings but never enumerates them. The 14 role slugs here are this fixture's own encoding. See CRITERIA-MAP.md gap G-03.

_meta.shape: ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1. Tier is implicit in field presence - no 'tier' field. A record with no 'ingredients' is tier 1; with 'ingredients' and no 'method' it is tier 2.

coverage.slotNotCovered: snack1 - by design. REQUIREMENTS.md §3.2: Snack 1 never draws from the book. See snack1.library.json.

designatedSpecialCases.tier1Only: syn-ridge-gourd-sambar - name, role, section, page, slots and nothing else. DSH-03.
designatedSpecialCases.noKannadaName: syn-tomato-saar - kannadaName field absent, not null, not empty. DSH-02.
designatedSpecialCases.unresolvedIngredient: syn-brinjal-masala-curry - ingredient 4 has unresolved: true. DSH-06.
designatedSpecialCases.roleWhereEveryRecipeIsSeasonal: role 'sasam' - both records carry season, and neither covers November. Deliberate collision fixture for GEN-08 vs GEN-19. See CRITERIA-MAP.md gap G-02.
designatedSpecialCases.sameDishInBreakfastAndSnack2: the six breakfast/idli/dosai records all carry slots ['breakfast','snack2']. GEN-07.
designatedSpecialCases.excludedFromSnack2: syn-brinjal-masala-curry (section 10) and syn-lime-pickle (section 28) are in the SNACK-LIBRARY.md §2.1 'Out' list. GEN-06 negative fixture.
designatedSpecialCases.needsReview: syn-colocasia-patholi - needsReview true. No criterion covers it; see gap G-14.
designatedSpecialCases.diacritics: syn-tomato-saar name, syn-neer-dosai and syn-appe-sweet kannadaName carry macrons. SRC-07.
designatedSpecialCases.stoplistHeavy: syn-dalithoy - 5 of its 8 ingredients are on the seasoning stoplist. DSH-04.

mainMealComposition._note: GEN-03 requires the main meal be composed by role. REQUIREMENTS.md §3 says 3-5 dishes; §3.3 and GEN-03 name four positions. The count is not pinned anywhere - see CRITERIA-MAP.md gap G-04. This fixture supplies a four-position reading so GEN-03 has something to assert against.

retiredIds._note: HST-06. These ids were never in a shipped corpus; they exist so a build-time lint has something to reject.
